{{Short description|Italian mathematician (1681–1749)}}
[[File:Capelli - Breve compendio d'operazioni geometriche da farsi colla sola riga, e compasso, 1765 - 74088.jpg|thumb|''Breve compendio d'operazioni geometriche'', 1765]]

'''Angelo Felice Capelli''' ([[Parma]], [[Duchy of Parma and Piacenza]] 2 November 1681 – [[Ceneda, Italy|Ceneda]], 16 November 1749) was an Italian [[mathematician]] and [[astronomer]].<ref>{{DBI|url=https://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/angelo-felice-capelli_(Dizionario-Biografico)/|title=CAPELLI, Angelo Felice|first=Ugo|last=Baldini|volume=18}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.beweb.chiesacattolica.it/persone/persona/11400/|title=Angelo Felice Capelli|editor=[[Episcopal Conference of Italy]]|website=BeWeB|language=it}}</ref>
